3. The quality lead could evaluate yearly reports of schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band [S26, S16]. Within 30 days, the quality lead and the clinical team decide which figures to report, serving the Goal 3 indicator "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26].

Distances run from municipality centre points, and Matka found no public page stating a schedule at these units [S59, S60].
